name: counter-strike-source-mod-manager
description: An open-source profile-based mod manager for Counter-Strike: Source.

scripts.build: vite build --config vite.main.config.ts && vite build --config vite.preload.config.ts && vite build --config vite.renderer.config.ts
scripts.start: node scripts/ensure-electron.mjs && npm run build && electron .vite/build/index.js
scripts.package: node scripts/ensure-electron.mjs && npm run build && electron-builder --dir --publish never
scripts.make: node scripts/ensure-electron.mjs && npm run build && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.release: node scripts/ensure-electron.mjs && npm run build && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.release:windows: node scripts/ensure-electron.mjs && npm run build && electron-builder --publish never --win nsis portable
scripts.release:linux: node scripts/ensure-electron.mjs && npm run build && electron-builder --publish never --linux AppImage deb
scripts.release:macos: node scripts/ensure-electron.mjs && npm run build && electron-builder --publish never --mac dmg zip
